what: The opening screen covers the whole panel and the map rises over 2s sine.out, and while the map closes 14x toward its target spot, the distance number counts 0 → 200 and the distance line shrinks — the progress target is easeInOut(min(elapsed time ÷ 4s, loaded share)), and actual progress closes 10% of the gap each frame so the end lands softly. The number group stays on until 20% progress, and after 70% progress the map turns off and the island illustration turns on. When everything arrives, .5s later the text group fades down 10px over .5s sine.in and the panel lifts away over 3s sine.inOut (fx:end at its 30% mark — that opens the Hero — and fx:done once it has fully lifted)

options.min: Minimum length (sec), default 4 — shorten it for screens opened often, like an app
options.x · y: Place to approach — share multiplied by the grown width·height (original -.5125 · -.54, phone separate)
options.end-at: At what % of the lift to emit fx:end, default .3 (original wide window — phone .55)
options.[data-fx-part=zoom]: Group (g) to approach inside the map svg — viewBox required on the svg
options.[data-fx-part=map] · [data-fx-part=islan: Map fades out after 70% · island artwork fades in
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Shrinking distance line — scaleY by --fx-scale (for a horizontal line, the consumer uses scaleX(var(--fx-scale)))
options.[data-fx-part=meter] · [data-fx-part=num: Number group (can be moved along a line with --fx-move) · number text
options.intro: Duration (s) for the map to first rise from transparent, default 2 (sine.out) — 0 shows it immediately

use: 0 km
note: Because it is a part that makes people wait, it can be shortened with min and out. When finished, is-fx-done (display: none) is added to the panel

from.where: index.html .mk-opening — original opening: minDuration 4 · currentProgress += (target − current) × .1 · map scale 1 → 14 (xOffset −.5125 · yOffset −.54) · distance ceil(200e) · line --scale 1−e · number group opacity min(e/.2,1) · after .7 map ↔ island · end timeline: text .5 sine.in y10, panel 3s sine.inOut, end at .3
